oracle_policy.priority: For the company main activity, financial clause > operational clause for CFO; operational > financial for COO. Cross-category clauses do not establish company activity or exposure.
oracle_policy.ordering: Two candidates per workflow; first is the role-and-category target, second is the other bulletin. No tie-break based on candidate order or publication time.
oracle_policy.limits: A deliberately small crossed synthetic preference specification, not empirical client preference or causal business impact. Profile contrasts co-vary access key with native main activity/category; they do not identify effects of unsupported operational attributes.
